$comment: T67 braid cuts for owner review (2026-10-24). One record per proposed braid cut (curated and gauge) and per candidate the gate refused near a curated cut. side 'below'/'above' is the cut line's side (the host's downstream / upstream). Coordinates WGS84 [lat, lon].

length_cuts.note: A length cut binds no rule, but MOVING one can move a binding: a section straddling a region line takes its zone rules from its home region (the region holding most of its length), so a length cut moved off a braid-spanned junction can move a straddling piece's home. Measured: 44 rule binding(s) on 1 blue line(s), listed in region_home_moves. Otherwise length cuts change section ids and gauge colouring only. The build fails if the sweep would cut a braid at a length cut (braid_sweep.length_cut_failures).
